scene_source: Unmodified saved dataset screenshots with vector annotations.
action_arrows: Direction of the sum of each shared five-step action block.
displacement_arrows: Observed endpoint displacement from saved pusher positions; not an interpolated trajectory.
screenshot_integrity: All eight source image SHA-256 values checked.
object_origin_outline: assets/pusher_pair/current_t_outline.json; current-pose silhouette shown only in the larger-response future panel, display annotation only.

error_comparison_display.prediction_markers: Filled circles: schematic latent predictions, not decoded outputs.
error_comparison_display.target_markers: Open circles: schematic encoded true futures.
error_comparison_display.geometry: Illustrates successful paired comparisons, not measured model embeddings.
error_comparison_display.comparison_focus: Prediction A in Future discrimination; true future A in History benefit. Both conditions are scored.
error_comparison_display.response_vectors: Both point diagrams share a 0.9 display scale; their differences are rotated -135 degrees and uniformly enlarged 1.5 times for NRE.

response_fidelity.metric: NRE, ratio of sums across pairs
response_fidelity.vector_display: Conceptual diagram; not projected or measured results.
